title: The Real Effects of PCAOB Inspection Reports on the M&A Deals of Non-Big 4 Accounting Firms

rival_explanations: target clients switch auditors because of a prior-year going concern opinion rather than the acquirer’s inspection report

context.industry_setting: non-Big 4 accounting (audit) firms in the U.S. audit market
context.sample_description: inspected non-Big 4 accounting firms that received one or more PCAOB inspection reports; the unit of observation is the accounting firm-year; data collected from the Audit Analytics data modules (Audit firm events, PCAOB Report, Audit opinion, Restatements, and Litigation modules)
context.sample_size: 797 non-Big 4 firms (9,732 firm-year observations); 711 M&A deals

data_sources.name: data modules on the Audit Analytics website (Audit firm events, PCAOB Report, Audit opinion, Restatements, and Litigation modules)
Accounting Today (2020 top 100 firms survey; used to assess construct validity of IMP)

analyses.label: Table 2 (univariate comparison of inspection deficiency rates between M&A and non-M&A firms; Panel A firm-level, Panel B firm-year level)
analyses.sample: 167 M&A firms vs 630 non-M&A firms (Panel A); 457 M&A firm-years vs 9,275 non-M&A firm-years (Panel B)

dv.name: PCAOB inspection deficiency rate
dv.measure: Part I deficiency rate (PartI_DEF%jt) and incidence of Part II quality control deficiencies (PartII_QCjt), compared across M&A vs non-M&A firms via t-tests

key_ivs.name: M&A firm status
key_ivs.measure: partition of firms into M&A firms (conduct one or more M&A deals) vs non-M&A firms

analyses.label: Table 4, columns (1)-(4) (Equation 1, main M&A activity regression; all non-Big 4 firms)

dv.name: M&A activity of the accounting firm

controls.name: Ln(#CLIENTSjt) (log of 1 plus number of public company audit clients at start of year t)
PYGROWTHjt (prior-year growth in log number of clients)
Ln(#OFFICESjt) (log of number of offices at start of year t)
Ln(#RESTATEjt) (log of 1 plus client restatement announcements over recent three years)
Ln(#SUEDjt) (log of 1 plus audit-related lawsuits over recent three years)
MKTSHAREjt (firm's share of total fees in its office cities)
HERFjt (Herfindahl index of concentration in firm's city market(s))
GDPjt (level of GDP in 2012 dollars in firm's state)

analyses.label: Table 4, columns (5)-(8) (Equation 1 re-estimated on triennially inspected firms)
